markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (69%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu holds 30% and is in the 90% conformal set; invasive is 0% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 69%, InSitu 30% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu | Two classes not separated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Agrees (Normal) | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term, but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; concept-model contribution +0.36 [F4] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- The largest concept term (normal lobules) failed its spot check, so Normal versus InSitu stays open.
- The image is a JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section; calibration was tested on only 132 images.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9:** per-region probe shows 94% and 95% invasive; confirm no invasion.
2. **Region 5:** top tumor-infiltrating-stroma region (validated concept); look for stromal invasion.
3. **Region 9:** top region for confined atypical cells (weak concept); look for an in situ lesion.
